patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンの　マークが　はいった　コップ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. ポケモンの　マークが　はいった　コップ = 'a cup that has a Pokémon logo on it'.
